recognize_zh: 骨髓切片呈高度細胞化，骨小樑旁的正常造血被一大片中型、卵圓核、淡灰藍色豐富胞質、細胞界限清楚的單一形態細胞取代，間雜嗜酸性顆粒的嗜酸球系細胞與散在巨核細胞，符合肥大細胞瀰漫浸潤。
features: Hypercellular marrow with diffuse sheets of medium-sized cells replacing normal hematopoiesis
Cells have round to oval, occasionally indented nuclei and moderate to abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm with distinct cell borders
Numerous interspersed eosinophils/eosinophilic precursors with bright red granules
Scattered megakaryocytes, some small or hypolobated
Bony trabecula at left; no fibrosis or granulomas evident at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is markedly hypercellular. Adjacent to a bony trabecula, normal hematopoietic elements are extensively replaced by diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized cells with oval to indented nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm with distinct borders, imparting a fried-egg appearance. Numerous eosinophils and scattered, partly small megakaryocytes are admixed. The morphology is consistent with diffuse marrow infiltration by mast cells, as seen in mast cell leukemia; confirmation with tryptase, CD117 and CD25 immunostains is recommended.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells also show fried-egg spacing but are small B cells (CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E-positive) without associated eosinophilia or tryptase positivity.
Blasts have finer chromatin with nucleoli and higher N:C ratio and are CD34/MPO or monocytic marker-positive and tryptase-negative.
Mast cells in PDGFRA neoplasms are usually loosely scattered or spindled rather than dense sheets and the lesion is defined by FIP1L1::PDGFRA fusion.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters with desmoplasia and is keratin-positive and CD117/tryptase-negative.
